title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: SHLD, STZ, SONC, AAPL, TGT & more
text: Check out which companies are making headlines before the bell: Sears Holdings — The company announced Thursday it is closing 64 Kmart stores and 39 Sears establishments. Sears said the shutdowns are expected to start between early March and April. Constellation Brands — The beer maker reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings.
